He discussed this with the Minister of Labour and Social Affairs Aleš Juchelka (ANO) on Monday, he told the deník.cz server. He summarized that the level of support for those over 52 years old will remain unchanged. Juchelka then specified the newly proposed changes: all age groups will retain the current support for retraining, and support for parents and caregivers returning to the labor market should be increased. Unemployment benefits for people under 52 should then be reduced.
